label: r2c3
name: half-roll, 128 envs, 2 epochs
hypothesis: Same as the 128-env candidate, but with 2 PPO epochs instead of 4. The fixed compute then buys about 1.8 times more fresh samples (about 225k steps, about 110 updates). Fresh designs may matter more than reusing samples when every episode has a new target. Refuted if it scores clearly below the 4-epoch 128-env candidate, meaning sample reuse is worth more than sample count here.
